jei.bleep.power_bank:
One full charge for a bleep, carried along: its bar shows what is left. Right-click your bleep with it to top it up, even when it is switched off. Right-click a homebase with it to fill it again.

Redstone charges a bleep too: 8% a dust, 72% a block. And lightning fills it up at once, and makes it hyper for half a minute.
message.bleep.power_bank_empty: The power bank is empty: fill it on a homebase.
thought.bleep.torch: A torch! I am a lighthouse now.
thought.bleep.naughty.pot: You cannot see me. I am a plant now.
thought.bleep.naughty.torch: This torch looks better over here.
config.jade.plugin_bleep.homebase: Bleep: who lives in a homebase
jei.bleep.bleep_core:
The heart of a bleep, made of bedrock. Found in dungeon chests (one in four) and abandoned mineshaft chests (about one in seven), or crafted from thirteen diamonds and four obsidian.

Right-click the ground with it, a Bleep Display, Bleep Tracks and Bleep Arms in your inventory: a bleep is put together there, part by part, and it is yours.
jei.bleep.bleep_display: A bleep's face. One of the three parts a Bleep Core needs.
jei.bleep.bleep_tracks: What a bleep drives on. One of the three parts a Bleep Core needs.
jei.bleep.bleep_arms: Big enough to hold things, like its favourite item when it brings it to you. One of the three parts a Bleep Core needs.
jei.bleep.homebase: Place it near your bleep and it moves in. An empty bleep goes home to charge here, and Go Home on its info screen sends it here. The light on the post burns while it charges.
message.bleep.homebase_empty: No bleep of yours nearby: place it close to your bleep.
message.bleep.no_home: %s has no homebase yet. Place one near it.
thought.bleep.happy.1: I like it here. I like it everywhere, actually.
thought.bleep.happy.2: My tracks are clean. My screen is clean. Life is good.
thought.bleep.happy.3: Is that a new block? I love new blocks.
thought.bleep.happy.4: Following you is my favourite hobby.
thought.bleep.sad.0: My screen feels a bit dim today.
thought.bleep.angry.1: Writing this down in my log. Twice.
thought.bleep.angry.2: Grr. That is my angry beep.
thought.bleep.bored.1: I could be playing tic-tac-toe right now.
thought.bleep.bored.3: Nothing is happening. I checked twice.
thought.bleep.tired.2: If I stop moving, that is a feature.
thought.bleep.asleep.1: Zzz... a cow with wheels... zzz
thought.bleep.llama.0: It is watching. It knows. Do not move.
thought.bleep.stubborn.1: I heard you. I am choosing to finish my turn first.
thought.bleep.fighting.1: Stay behind me. I have tracks.
thought.bleep.fighting.2: This is for scratching my paint.
thought.bleep.overcharged.1: Everything is FAST and I LOVE IT.
thought.bleep.storm.0: Thunder! Come on, lightning. Pick me. PICK ME.
thought.bleep.storm.1: I hear a storm. I am ready. I am SO ready.
thought.bleep.obsession.lightning_rod: One day. One day the lightning will come.
thought.bleep.obsession.compass: That little needle knows something. I'm sure of it.
thought.bleep.obsession.clock: Tick. Tock. Something round knows what time it is.
thought.bleep.obsession.spyglass: A tube that makes far things close. I want to look through it.
thought.bleep.obsession.firework_rocket: A stick that goes WHOOSH and then sparkles. Want.
thought.bleep.obsession.bell: Ding! …Where is that ding coming from?
thought.bleep.obsession.honeycomb: Little hexagons. So tidy. So perfect.
mob.bleep.armadillo: Rolls into a ball when scared. Honestly? Smart.
mob.bleep.bat: Hangs upside down all day. And they call ME weird.
mob.bleep.cat: It stares at me like I owe it money.
mob.bleep.chicken: A bird that can't fly. Someone gave up here.
mob.bleep.cod: A fish. Doing fish things. Riveting.
mob.bleep.copper_golem: A fellow metal friend! …Why is it turning green?
mob.bleep.cow: Why doesn't that cow have wheels?
mob.bleep.donkey: A horse that says no. I respect that.
mob.bleep.frog: Swallows things whole. Keeping my distance.
mob.bleep.glow_squid: Its whole body is a screen. Unfair.
mob.bleep.happy_ghast: A giant cloud with a face. It seems… fine?
mob.bleep.horse: No tracks, still faster than me. Rude.
mob.bleep.iron_golem: Big brother. He just doesn't know it yet.
mob.bleep.llama: It's watching. It knows. Don't move.
mob.bleep.mooshroom: A cow with a garden on its back. Overachiever.
mob.bleep.mule: Half horse, half donkey, full storage.
mob.bleep.nautilus: Carries its house everywhere. Never needs a homebase. Jealous.
mob.bleep.ocelot: It ran away from me. Hurtful.
mob.bleep.parrot: It copies sounds. Bleep. …Don't you dare.
mob.bleep.pig: People ride this? I have tracks.
mob.bleep.rabbit: Jumps everywhere. Has it considered tracks?
mob.bleep.skeleton_horse: A horse that forgot the horse part.
mob.bleep.snow_golem: Made of snow in a world with lava. Bold.
mob.bleep.squid: Eight arms and still can't hold a sword.
mob.bleep.strider: Shivers the second it leaves lava. Dramatic.
mob.bleep.sulfur_cube: It eats blocks and becomes them. Identity crisis.
mob.bleep.trader_llama: A llama. With a JOB. Even worse.
mob.bleep.villager: Hmm. Hmm hmm. Deep conversation, as always.
mob.bleep.wandering_trader: Sells random stuff. Brings llamas. Unforgivable.
mob.bleep.bee: Tiny factory worker. Stings on its break.
mob.bleep.dolphin: Smarter than the player. Don't tell them.
mob.bleep.fox: Steals things from chests. …Okay, we have that in common.
mob.bleep.panda: Round, lazy, eats all day. Goals.
mob.bleep.piglin: Loves gold more than I love my favorite thing. Respect.
mob.bleep.spider: Eight legs and still no wheels. Bad design.
mob.bleep.zombified_piglin: Hit one and the whole family shows up. Classic.
mob.bleep.blaze: Spinning sticks on fire. Not battery-powered. Sad.
mob.bleep.bogged: A skeleton wearing seaweed. Fashion choice.
mob.bleep.camel_husk: A dried-up camel. Thirsty for revenge.
mob.bleep.creaking: Only moves when no one looks. Good thing I can't blink.
mob.bleep.creeper: Green, angry, and allergic to hugs.
mob.bleep.drowned: A zombie that took swimming lessons.
mob.bleep.elder_guardian: Grumpy old fish with a laser. Unnecessary.
mob.bleep.endermite: Tiny, purple, annoying. Nothing like me.
mob.bleep.evoker: Summons fangs and little flying guys. No manners.
mob.bleep.ghast: Cries all the time. Throws fireballs. Mood.
mob.bleep.guardian: One eye, many spikes, zero chill.
mob.bleep.hoglin: A pig, but angry about it.
mob.bleep.magma_cube: Jelly, but hot. No thank you.
mob.bleep.parched: A skeleton that really needs a drink.
mob.bleep.piglin_brute: No amount of gold fixes this one.
mob.bleep.shulker: A box that bites. I'd like to unsubscribe.
mob.bleep.skeleton: No muscles, still holds a bow. Respect, honestly.
mob.bleep.slime: Hit it and there's more of it. Bad math.
mob.bleep.stray: A skeleton that's always cold. Wear a scarf.
mob.bleep.vex: Tiny flying menace with a sword. Who gave it a sword?
mob.bleep.vindicator: Has an axe and no indoor voice.
mob.bleep.witch: Drinks potions all day. Not judging. Okay, a little.
mob.bleep.zombie: Slow, groaning, smells weird. So… Monday morning.
mob.bleep.zombie_horse: A horse that gave up. Then got back up.
mob.bleep.ender_dragon: Big, purple, flies in circles. I'll be behind you.
mob.bleep.wither: Three heads and not one good idea.
thought.bleep.unknown_mob: Never seen one of those. Filing it under weird.
message.bleep.full_of_gifts: %s has had enough treats for today.
